checks.result: Read and visually inspected author PDF page6, including all of section2.3.a and start of2.3.b. The request expressly extends disclosure to telecommunications and email providers. The disputed prepaid-verification sentence supplies an express reason for identifying account owners through telephone numbers. The preceding frequency qualification remains in the candidate limits.

A German-only reading is possible as an explanation of a drafting slip, particularly because the example uses German Post-Ident. However the paragraph twice invokes the EU and does not expressly limit the verification proposition to German numbers. The categorical geographical sentence overstates the scope even though the preceding broader efficacy proposition is frequency-qualified. Retain a narrowly framed geographical overgeneralisation, not a claim that all telephone-number identification is impossible.

Independently opened Council Presidency note5556/25,28January2025, and read all4pages. Page2 explicitly distinguishes Member States permitting anonymous purchases from states requiring registration. Absence of an EU-level rule alone would not suffice because all national rules could theoretically converge; the same page's affirmative description of divergent national regimes is the relevant additional evidence. Independently opened Finnish Traficom porting instructions, which recognises anonymous prepaid services, and DNA current support/retail pages, which explicitly permits purchase and activation without registration or ID. Read archived Elisa terms section2 permitting activation without identity authentication.

The Council note precedes the22May2026submission. The2013Elisa terms remain publicly served and current regulator/operator pages agree. This triangulation is strong, but current webpages alone should not be described as a contemporaneous22May2026snapshot. I searched for a2026Finnish mandatory SIM-registration change and found no primary evidence of such a change; absence of that search result is not itself proof. Candidate accurately labels dates and does not rely solely on a current retailer page.

Checked archived ministry draft header16April2026 14:37 and read Article1§1(2),§1(3),§2(1) and relevant definitions at PDFpages4–5. The restricted provider scope described by the request is present. No need to substitute a later Cabinet version or assume that the request was already granted.

Minor is appropriate: correcting the EU-wide generalisation narrows the potential utility of the extension, while German identification duties and many useful provider records can remain. The erroneous breadth favours the requested extension, but does not establish that the extension is ineffective or undesirable.

optional_precision: In the correction, stress that the Council note affirmatively describes anonymous-purchase Member States; no EU harmonisation by itself does not prove no convergent national requirement.
